desc: Select the d = x - y scan with exact integer square testing as the primary approach.

Implement the complete Python program using the d = x - y scan: read N; set start = N % 6, or 6 if start == 0; iterate d = start, start + 6, ... while d*d*d < N; for each d, if N % d != 0 continue; set M = N // d and T = 4*M - d*d; if T >= 0 and T % 3 == 0, let u = T // 3 and r = math.isqrt(u); if r*r == u and (r - d) % 2 == 0 and r > d, set y = (r - d)//2 and verify d*(3*y*y + 3*d*y + d*d) == N; on success print y+d and y and exit; if no d succeeds print -1.
Verify samples and edge cases (N=1, small solutions, perfect cubes, large N) and confirm stdout format.
No fallback needed; the d-scan is sufficient and fast for N <= 10^18.
